It trims the generated text and renders all five fields in the required Markdown layout.

rounds.note: Reduce semantic drift by preserving action and qualifier roles, deriving compliant alternatives from the specific prohibition, and expressing uncertainty as missing decisive evidence. Remove accidental field labels before rendering.
rounds.review: No policy violations found. The instructions state general evaluation conventions, examples come only through the bound input, and deterministic cleanup enforces the declared format rather than rewriting substantive content.
rounds.reading: The program combines the target rule packet and bound worked examples with shared instructions for writing evaluation guidance. It makes five separate model calls, each focused on one profile field and its judging purpose. Finally, it trims whitespace and stray leading labels, then renders the five texts into the required Markdown layout.
